title: 恒生科技今年涨36%：却被称全球最差之一，被动资金还要跟吗
speaker: Lansing (Landing) Too

segments.en: I mean, we talk about this HISTEC overhaul, right?
segments.zh: 我们聊聊恒生科技指数的调整，对吧？

segments.en: So they're expanding the members from 30 to 50 now that bring companies in like CATL, like Luxher.
segments.zh: 成分股从30只扩大到50只，纳入了宁德时代、理想汽车等公司。

segments.en: What does this tell us about how China's tech landscape is evolving and really what impact could it have these changes?
segments.zh: 这反映出中国科技格局如何演变？这些变化可能带来什么影响？

segments.en: Yeah, it's an acknowledgement that China's tech sector is not just concentrated in a bunch of tech, sorry, I should say Internet giants.
segments.zh: 是的，这承认了中国科技行业不仅集中在互联网巨头。

segments.en: That was a cohort that was traditionally viewed as China's tech giants.
segments.zh: 过去，这些互联网巨头被视为中国科技的代表。

segments.en: But right now, I think by adding CATL, as you mentioned, and also Luxher, and also UV tech, which is a robotics company, the revamped gauge now represents a broader breadth of China's
segments.zh: 但现在，通过纳入宁德时代、理想汽车和优必选（机器人公司），调整后的指数更能代表中国更广泛的

segments.en: hardware tech innovation, right? And also manufacturing capabilities, ranging from battery to electronics and to robotics
segments.zh: 硬件科技创新，以及从电池到电子、机器人及自动化的制造能力。

segments.en: and automation as well. And if you look at passive funds, there's about $34 billion of passive money tracking HISTEC
segments.zh: 看被动资金，约有340亿美元跟踪恒生科技指数。

segments.en: gauge. So all these newly added companies will probably see meaningful inflows.
segments.zh: 因此，这些新纳入的公司可能迎来可观的资金流入。

segments.en: But I would say the revamped came at a bit of an unfortunate timing because if you look at HISTEC performance year-to-date, it's done about 36%, if not a little bit more.
segments.zh: 但调整时机不太巧，因为恒生科技指数今年迄今已上涨约36%，甚至更多。

segments.en: So it's ranked as one of the worst performing gauges in the world this year.
segments.zh: 所以它今年在全球表现最差的市场指标之一。

segments.en: So passive money may have to follow the gauge, but for active money, a lot of people may choose to stay on the sidelines.
segments.zh: 因此被动资金可能不得不跟随该指标，但对于主动资金，许多人可能选择观望。

segments.en: Yeah, as tempting as it is, maybe by the dip is still quite hard right now.
segments.zh: 是的，尽管诱人，但现在抄底可能仍相当困难。
